# dsh-tui-pi
A fully-featured pi-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — a plugin suite that turns dsh int
o a pi-like coding-agent experience: /history look-back & fork-at-turn, guided preset switching, liv
e subagent steering, model profiles, 20+ built-in themes (10 light + 10 dark) with user theme direct
ory discovery, and a powerline footer.
**Requires dsh >= 0.2.2-rc.1** — this plugin targets the dsh RC/stable line only (CI and releases re
solve the newest of the `latest`/`next` dist-tags at runtime). **The alpha line is no longer support
ed.** A startup guard logs a one-line warning and exits cleanly when the host is older than the floo
r (opt out with `DSH_TUI_SKIP_HOST_CHECK=1`). See ADR 0002 for the now-superseded alpha single-targe
with `DSH_TUI_SKIP_HOST_CHECK=1`). See ADR 0002 for the now-superseded alpha single-target decision.
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/67a7c6ca-ff42-4005-b543-437ba61771bb
*A live recording of a session (MP4, 1.5× speed) — todos, running subagents, think/tool panels and t
he powerline footer in action.*
## ✨ Features
> Each item links to its own doc under `docs/features/` — one line here, the details (and demo video
em links to its own doc under `docs/features/` — one line here, the details (and demo videos) there.
- **Footer — live session overview** — provider/model, context pressure and the session cache-hit ra

te at a glance, always in view.
- **Think & tool panels** — reasoning and tool activity stay out of

the transcript, so the conversation reads clean.
- **Subagents** — every running subagent gets a sta

tus line; watch its live transcript and decode speed (tok/s), steer it in place.
- **Tool approvals*

* — review the operation and allow it once or deny it; no automatic approval.
- **Ask User Question*

* — the model can pause and ask you structured questions, answered without leaving the TUI.
- **Feis
hu integration** — dsh-tui-pi on the desktop and Feishu/Lark on the phone driving (and answering for

) the same dsh session.
- **Dynamic context pruning (DCP)** — context stays within limits automatica

lly, with zero LLM calls.
- **Persistent context** — your ground rules ride along on every request,

hot-applied with no restart.
- **Model profiles & favorites** — profile switching lives in dsh-profi
le-switch now; this suite keeps the TUI read side (session seeding from the pin, live-selection brid

ge, scope-aware `/agents` edits) and the `/model` favorites that keep the picker small.
- **Agent pr
eset switching** — `/preset` between the agent presets the host's 0.1.7 registry declares (`standard
`, `minimal`, …); a switch is confirmed and starts a NEW session on the preset (the current one stay
s resumable); what a preset really gates, and how to migrate a 0.1.5 directory preset (same-id bundl

e patch).
- **Sessions & resume** — sessions stay tidy automatically and resume in a few keystrokes;
`/session` breaks out the session's decode speed and per-model usage; the host's kernel write lease

keeps the log single-writer across processes.
- **History browser** — `/history` opens a fixed two-
pane look-back over the session: completed turns on the left, the selected turn's replies on the rig
ht; copy a prompt back to the editor, or cold-read any stored session without resuming it (read-only

prompt back to the editor, or cold-read any stored session without resuming it (read-only).

## Install and launch
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The global install sets the machine up by itself, printing one progress line per step: it installs t
he `@deepseek-ai/dsh` host when missing (via npm, resolved as the newest of the `latest`/`next` dist
-tags — the `latest` tag alone lags the rc line; if npm itself is not on PATH, it prints what to ins
tall and stops), installs pnpm, and creates the `tui` profile with this plugin and its bundled compa
nions. Host compatibility window: **0.2.2-rc.1 and newer** — a host at or above the floor is kept as
-is; an older one is upgraded automatically. Whatever the install cannot finish (e.g. an offline mac
hine) completes automatically on the first launch. After a later `npm i -g` upgrade of this package,
the profile's mounted copy is moved to the new version on the next launch — a profile that is newer
than the global install (dev-upgraded ahead) is left untouched.
The manual steps do exactly what the onboarding runs, if you prefer them:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Never add `@deepseek-ai/*` packages to a profile by hand — the host provides them, and their npm `la
test` tag is a 0.0.1 stub (a bare-name `pnpm add @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` lands that stub next to the p
lugin and shadows the host's copy; the symptom is the loader's `does not provide an export named …`
and the plugin not activating). The `dsh-tui-pi` launcher checks for exactly this before every boot
and, when it finds a shadowing copy, stops with both paths, both versions and the removal commands i
nstead of booting into the broken state.
Legacy `session_projcache` records (written before dsh 0.1.2-alpha.4) are migrated automatically at
profile load — idempotent, with per-file backups, never blocking startup; the `dsh-tui-pi` launcher
runs the same preflight.
Everything that used to need manual patching — the canvas background, the `@deepseek-ai` module clos
ure, the compaction backend — now happens automatically. For a normal install, upgrading the global
package upgrades the profile on the next launch (see above). `dev-upgrade` remains for dev machines
that install the profile from a checked-out repo:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The `dsh-tui-pi` bin shim is global and can stay; if you installed the package globally and want it
gone too: `npm -g rm @aiwayds/dsh-tui-pi`.
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility note
Resuming, under a dsh 0.1.6 host, a session saved under dsh 0.1.5-rc.2 whose subagent completion not
ices carried reasoning content fails to serialize the first model request (upstream B-21 — host-side
data issue, not a plugin defect). If `/resume` fails this way, start a new session instead.
